entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I... um... I need to return something. My VeloBand GPS Tracker.

Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band, or more of a preference issue?
Oh, um, a preference, I guess? It was a bit of an impulse buy, and to be honest, I just don't use it. I think I've only taken it out of the box once. I basically changed my mind right after I got it.
I was getting so worried I'd be stuck with it, or that I'd have to figure out some kind of resale website. All of that is so overwhelming. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I understand completely. No need to worry about any of that. Let me just pull up your order details. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, it's Michael Chen, order number 788-125B.
Thank you, Michael. One moment... Okay, I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you 42 days ago.
Looking at our policy, it seems you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. So, we can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh! Really? Are you sure? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much!

You are very welcome. I have just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Once our warehouse receives the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
Wow, that's perfect. You've made this so simple. I really appreciate your help, Sarah.
It's my pleasure, Michael. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
